about: What a run of bun_fs_slice may print on a host that is not Linux where expected/linux.jsonl has something else. compare-run.ts reads this file. A step is named as in the output; a step with a path is "<step> <path>".

symlink a/link -> renamed.txt.why: Windows makes a symbolic link for an administrator, or for everybody when Developer Mode is on: libuv reports ERROR_PRIVILEGE_NOT_HELD as EPERM

unlink, directory a/side.why: libuv's unlink for Windows refuses a directory with ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, which is EPERM (vendor/libuv/src/win/fs.c, fs__unlink), as Node.js does on Windows
unlink(2) of macOS gives EPERM for a directory

every_host.syscall: the name of the system call that bun attributes an error to is compared on Linux only: bun's code for another OS reaches the same result through other calls
